hero.lead: The first technology immersion program built for Africa's exceptional leaders. Six days in Silicon Valley, six eligible countries, 75 scholarships.
hero.freeBadge: Applying is 100% free — no fee before pre-selection

why.title: Direct access, not a guided tour.
why.description: For the first time, a structured program connects Africa's most ambitious leaders directly to Silicon Valley's investors, founders and giants — anchored firmly in the economic realities of our own markets.

network.title: Global network
network.description: Direct access to leaders at the world's technology giants and to investment funds active in Africa. Every meeting is arranged to maximise your impact.

immersion.title: Tech immersion
immersion.description: Stanford, Apple, Tesla, Meta, Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet. Understand from the inside how AI, blockchain and fintech will reshape your sectors.

africa.title: Built for Africa
africa.description: Unlike generic programs, this curriculum is designed for our markets: diaspora financing, Mobile Money, regional integration, new trade routes.

certification.title: Official certification
certification.description: A First Of All African leader certificate recognised by chambers of commerce and partner institutions — a strong signal to your partners, clients and investors.

impact.title: Concrete impact
impact.description: Every participant leaves with a personalised strategic plan, qualified contacts, and lifetime access to the First Of All Africa community.

selection.title: Competitive selection
selection.description: Places are limited. Rigorous selection guarantees the calibre of participants and the depth of the exchanges. Being selected is itself recognition.

page.title: Five ways to take part
page.lead: The same process applies to every pack: free application, automatic pre-selection, then verification. The number of places shown is how many participants are selected once verification is complete — it does not limit how many people may apply.

process.title: From application to departure, in 5 steps

step1.title: Free application
step1.description: An online eligibility form. No payment and no documents at this stage.

step2.title: Automatic pre-selection
step2.description: The system checks the eligibility criteria on submission. Immediate answer.

step3.title: Immediate access code
step3.description: A unique code, tied to your name and email, is sent immediately and opens Phase 2 for 14 days.

step4.title: Verification
step4.description: Full details, verification fee, supporting documents and — depending on your pack — proof of financial capacity or of your project. Checks start after payment.

page.title: Who can apply?
page.lead: The program is open to nationals and residents of six countries. The criteria are deliberately simple and verifiable — you'll know immediately whether your profile moves forward.

countries.title: Participating countries — 2026 edition
countries.lead: For this edition, priority was given to countries still broadly eligible for B1 and B2 visas. Further countries may be added in future editions.

eligibleItems: Any national or resident of one of the 6 participating countries
Minimum age: 18 (or the legal age of majority in your country)
Clean criminal record or legal equivalent
Genuine motivation to take part and contribute to your community
Confirmed intention to return to your home country
ineligibleItems: People seeking only a visa or a travel opportunity with no real commitment
Nationals who have already had 4 or more US visa refusals

automatic.title: What the system checks automatically
automatic.lead: On submission, four criteria are checked instantly. If you meet them, you're pre-selected and your access code is emailed to you immediately.
items: Your country of residence is one of the 6 participating countries
You are 18 or over
You declare a clean criminal record
You declare fewer than 4 US visa refusals
automatic.note: The three qualitative criteria — motivation, impact of the trip, return home — are assessed by a human committee after verification, when places are allocated.

criteria.title: Our three assessment pillars
criteria.lead: Every application is assessed against three fundamental pillars, whichever pack is chosen.

pillar1.title: Motivation
pillar1.description: Clear, genuine, and grounded in a concrete project or a measurable professional ambition. This isn't a writing exercise: we're looking for what you intend to do, specifically.

pillar2.title: Impact of the trip
pillar2.description: The potential impact on your career, your company or your project, and the concrete benefits you expect from it.

pillar3.title: Return home
pillar3.description: Your willingness to return and pass on what the program gives you. This is the central criterion: we value lasting local impact.

bourses.title: 75 scholarships available
bourses.lead: For high-potential applicants facing financial constraints. Awards are never automatic: they're decided on file, after in-depth review.

faq.title: Everything you need before applying
faq.lead: If your question isn't here, contact us — we answer.

items.a: Yes, entirely, for all five packs. No payment is requested in Phase 1. Verification fees apply only in Phase 2, only if you are pre-selected, and only on this site.

If you're pre-selected, your unique access code in the format SVAP-XXXX-XXXX is emailed to you immediately after you submit. Then go to “Get my documents” and enter your full name along with that code.

items.q: What if I lose my access code?
items.a: Use the “Resend code” button on the “Get my documents” page. Your full name and email must match your application. A new code automatically cancels the previous one.

items.q: How long does my code stay valid?
items.a: 14 days from issue. After that you can request a new one. Once the code is used, your session stays open for 72 hours and you can switch devices — start on a computer and photograph your documents with your phone, for instance.

Laureate 20 USD · Scholar 30 USD · Delegate 30 USD · Business Visitor 330 USD · VIP Visitor 330 USD. They cover identity verification, the criminal record check, the non-return risk assessment and the processing of your file.

items.q: Do these fees guarantee a place?
items.a: No, and this matters. They cover the verification of your file, not the award of a place. The number of places shown on each pack is how many participants are selected once verification is complete; it does not limit how many people may apply.

No. They pay for work actually carried out on your file — identity verification, the criminal record check, the non-return risk assessment and administrative processing — whether or not the outcome is in your favour. It's also why they are deliberately kept low for the scholarship packs (20 and 30 USD). What the programme does commit to paying is a premium if your visa is refused after your file has been validated.

items.q: Does my pack require additional documents?
items.a: It depends on the pack. Laureate submits a one-page project summary. Scholar adds a 5,000 USD bank attestation, proof they can fund the flight, and travel insurance. Business Visitor and VIP Visitor evidence the full cost of their trip (roughly 13,940 USD and 20,940 USD respectively), with a bank attestation, the last two months of statements, the source of funds and travel insurance. Delegate has no such documents to provide.

items.q: Do I have to pay these amounts to the programme?
items.a: No, never. The programme does not receive, hold or manage the funds for your trip: you book and pay for your own flight, hotel and transport, with the providers of your choice. Only the verification fee — and, for the VIP Visitor pack, the sponsoring contribution arranged directly with the administration after validation — is paid to the programme.

By Mobile Money in Cameroon, Kenya and Ghana (MTN, Orange, M-Pesa depending on your operator), or by bank card from all six countries. Mobile Money isn't available in Morocco, Egypt and South Africa: card is the only method there.

items.q: How do I know the program is genuine?
items.a: The program is run by First Of All LLC, a company registered in the United States (Santa Fe), with subsidiaries in London and Ontario. All payments go exclusively through our approved providers on this site, with an immediate receipt — never by personal transfer or Mobile Money sent to an individual. If someone asks you to pay outside the official site, it's attempted fraud.

items.q: Are my data and documents protected?
items.a: Your passport number is encrypted at rest and never displayed in plain text. Your identity documents are held in private storage, reachable only through 60-second temporary links, and every access is logged. Access codes are hashed server-side. A DPO is appointed and you have rights of access, rectification and erasure.

items.q: What happens if my US visa is refused?
items.a: If your file was validated after our checks and the visa is subsequently refused, a premium is paid: 1,000 USD for Laureates, 500 USD for Scholars and 4,500 USD for VIP Visitors. Payment is subject to documentary verification of the official refusal issued by US consular authorities and to an internal audit, within 60 days of receiving the document. The Business Visitor pack carries no premium.

items.q: What's the difference between the packs?
items.a: Laureate and Scholar are scholarship places, fully or partly funded, awarded on file by a committee. Business Visitor and VIP Visitor are self-funded, with automatic selection if the eligibility criteria are met. VIP Visitor adds personalised pitch coaching and dedicated assistance. Delegate is a paid three-month role, not a trip.

items.q: Is the program open to all African countries?
items.a: Not for this edition. Priority was given to countries still broadly eligible for B1 and B2 visas: South Africa, Morocco, Cameroon, Kenya, Ghana and Egypt. Further countries may be added in future editions.

fraudRules: You are never asked for payment before pre-selection.
All payments happen on this site, never by personal transfer or Mobile Money sent to an individual.
Every payment generates an immediate receipt sent by email.
Nobody will ask for your access code by phone, WhatsApp or social media.
All official communication goes through the email address on your application.

securityItems.title: Encrypted passport number
securityItems.description: Encrypted at rest. Our team sees only the last two characters; full display is restricted to super-administrators and systematically logged.

securityItems.title: Documents in private storage
securityItems.description: Your identity documents are reachable only through temporary links valid for 60 seconds. Every access is written to a tamper-proof audit log.

securityItems.title: Hashed access codes
securityItems.description: Your code exists in plain text nowhere on our servers. It can't be displayed or recovered — a lost code is replaced, never retrieved.

securityItems.title: Rate-limited attempts
securityItems.description: The number of attempts on the access page is capped and every attempt is logged.

securityItems.title: Traceable payments
securityItems.description: Every transaction is recorded with its reference, amount and timestamp, and confirmed by the payment provider.

securityItems.title: Your rights
securityItems.description: A data protection officer is appointed. You have rights of access, rectification and erasure of your data.

sections.title: Purpose of processing
sections.body: Your data is processed for the sole purpose of assessing your application: eligibility checks, identity and criminal record verification, file review, payment processing and, if validated, assembling the visa file.

sections.title: Security measures actually implemented
items: Your passport number is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). It never appears in plain text in the admin interface; only the last two characters are visible.
Your supporting documents are held in private storage, reachable only through temporary links valid for 60 seconds.
Every document access and every passport-number display is written to a tamper-proof audit log, with the administrator's identity, the date and the IP address.
Access codes are hashed server-side and exist in plain text nowhere.
Phase 2 access attempts are rate-limited and logged.
Access to the most sensitive data is restricted to super-administrators.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.body: Identity documents are retained for 12 months from submission, then automatically deleted. Application data is retained for as long as necessary to assess the file and to meet applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have rights of access, rectification and erasure of your data, as well as rights of objection and portability. These requests should be addressed to the DPO. An identity check may be required before any request is processed.

conditions-generales.title: Terms and conditions
conditions-generales.lead: The rules governing application, verification and participation in the program.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern applications to the Silicon Valley Africa Program, 2026 edition, operated by First Of All LLC.

sections.title: Phase 1 is free
sections.body: Applying is entirely free for all five packs. No payment is requested before pre-selection. Any request for payment in Phase 1, or outside this site, is attempted fraud.

sections.title: Verification fees — Phase 2
items: Laureate: 20 USD
Scholar: 30 USD
Delegate: 30 USD
Business Visitor: 330 USD
VIP Visitor: 330 USD

sections.title: What the verification fee covers
sections.body: The fee covers identity verification, the criminal record check, the non-return risk assessment and administrative processing of the file. It does not constitute the purchase of a place: places are allocated after verification. The fee is not refundable, the service being rendered as soon as it is paid.

sections.title: Documents specific to each pack
sections.body: Depending on the pack chosen, Phase 2 includes an additional evidence step: a project summary for Laureate; a 5,000 USD bank attestation, proof the flight can be funded, travel insurance and a project summary for Scholar; evidence of the full cost of the trip, the last two months of bank statements, the source of funds and travel insurance for Business Visitor and VIP Visitor. The Delegate pack is not concerned. These amounts are never paid to the program: candidates book and pay for their own travel services.

sections.title: Access code
sections.body: The access code is personal, tied to your full name and email address, single-use and valid for 14 days. It cannot be shared or transferred. A new code automatically cancels the previous one.

sections.title: Selection and number of places
sections.body: Phase 1 pre-selection is automatic and based on verifiable criteria; no application is refused on the grounds that a pack is full. The number of places announced for each pack is the maximum number of participants selected once verification is complete. Final allocation of places for the Laureate, Scholar and Delegate packs is a committee decision made on file. Business Visitor and VIP Visitor are selected automatically where eligibility criteria are met and verification is conclusive, within the limit of available places.

sections.title: Visa-refusal premiums
sections.body: The Laureate, Scholar and VIP Visitor packs carry a premium in the event of a US visa refusal after the file has been validated, on the conditions set out in the premiums policy.

sections.title: VIP Visitor sponsorship contribution
sections.body: The 7,000 USD sponsorship contribution applicable to the VIP Visitor pack is due only after the file has been validated following verification. It is arranged directly with the program administration and is never paid on this site.

sections.title: Fraud
sections.body: In the event of proven documentary fraud, the application is permanently rejected, no premium is due and a report to the competent authorities is possible.

sections.title: Liability, governing law and jurisdiction
sections.body: Limitation of liability, force majeure, program modification, governing law and competent court for each of the six jurisdictions concerned.

primes.title: Visa-refusal premiums
primes.lead: What verification fees cover, why they are not refundable, and on what conditions a premium is paid if your US visa is refused.

sections.title: Not pre-selected in Phase 1
sections.body: No fee was requested and none will be. There is therefore nothing to refund. Your file remains eligible for future editions of the program.

sections.title: Verification fees are not refundable
sections.body: Phase 2 verification fees are not refundable, whatever the outcome of your file. They pay for a service actually rendered: identity verification, the criminal record check carried out through a local partner provider, the non-return risk assessment and the administrative processing of the file. That work is performed as soon as payment is made, independently of the final decision.

sections.title: Not selected after verification
sections.body: The number of places on each pack is the number of participants selected once verification is complete. A file that passes verification but is not selected does not give rise to a refund of the verification fee. It is kept and reviewed as a priority for the following edition.

sections.title: Proven fraud
sections.body: The file is permanently rejected, no premium is due and the matter may be reported to the competent authorities.

sections.title: Premiums in the event of a US visa refusal
sections.body: If your file was validated after our checks and US consular authorities subsequently refuse your visa, a premium is paid according to your pack:
items: Laureate: 1,000 USD
Scholar: 500 USD
VIP Visitor: 4,500 USD
Business Visitor and Delegate: no premium

sections.title: Conditions for paying premiums
items: The file must have been validated by the program before the visa application. A file rejected after verification gives rise to no entitlement.
The refusal must be established by an official document issued by US consular authorities and sent to the program.
The file is subject to an internal audit before any payment.
Payment is made within 60 days of receiving the refusal document.

sections.title: Sums the program does not collect
sections.body: The amounts you evidence at the “Capacity and project” step (flight, accommodation, transport, meals) are never paid to the program. You book and pay for those services yourself, with the providers of your choice. Only the verification fee and, for the VIP Visitor pack, the sponsoring contribution arranged directly with the administration after validation, are paid to the program.

sections.title: Complaints and appeals
sections.body: Complaints procedure regarding payment of a premium, contractual processing time and appeal arrangements in each of the six jurisdictions concerned.
